topics.topic: Upload closure-check read transaction ownership and lifetime
questions: Which module opens and owns the upload's `store.read_in_transaction`, and does it remain open through the closure check only or through validation and replacement of the session's uploaded file?
During upload, does `operations` open one `store.read_in_transaction` around the closure check, and for exactly which part of the upload request is that transaction held?

quotes: `module:store`. Run one read in one read transaction (A14 rule 4).
The read to run, which receives the transaction.
The read's answer, from one consistent view of the store.
The read transaction; the mode, `upload` or `mapping`; the file's bytes;

`module:owner_sessions`. Keep an accepted upload in the session's memory,
replacing the session's earlier one (A16 rule 2).
judgement.why: State 5 makes `operations` the caller that opens the single read transaction passed to `migration_import.read_import_mapping`; that read returns before the separate `owner_sessions.keep_uploaded_file` call replaces session state.

topics.topic: Confirmation-step fresh closure-check ownership and transaction relationship to mapping
questions: Which module and capability perform the confirmation step's fresh closure check, and is this a distinct read transaction from the mapping request or part of the same request and transaction?

quotes:
Every operation of a domain module —
  `customers`, `projects`, `artifact_pointers`, `agent_sessions`,
  `migration_import`, `audit_log` — that reads or writes the store takes the
  transaction `operations` opened through `store.run_in_transaction` or
  `store.read_in_transaction` as an input, and never opens, commits or
  rolls back one (State 3, "One action, one transaction").

`module:migration_import`. Read an uploaded export file as data and answer
its projects, or, for the owner's picks, the mapping (A16 rules 1, 3–5).
The read transaction; the mode, `upload` or `mapping`; the file's bytes;

and whether the mapping is clean — no malformed record, no conflict,
no missing value and at least one pick — which alone lets the confirmation
step be shown.

The closure first and alone: when it exists, `import_closed` is the answer,
before any other check (A16 rule 8; Conventions, "Stages").

None of its own; `migration_import` decides whether the import's step may be
shown (A16 rule 1).
judgement.why: State 5 requires `operations` to open a read transaction for the confirmation-step request, pass it to `migration_import.read_import_mapping`, and show the step only when that fresh mapping finds no closure and is clean.
